description: Returns the details of a single SIO for a given SIOKEY (wraps NBAPI GetSio). Note: the v2 guide's worked example for GetSio sends MERCURYKEY, but its Calling Parameters list — which the guide makes authoritative — specifies SIOKEY, so SIOKEY is what this tool sends.

SIOKEY.description: Required. The key of the SIO to retrieve. Use get_sios to discover keys.

name: get_sio
